Prague-based early-stage venture capital firm KAYA has completed the first close of its fifth fund, which is worth €70 million. The new fund plans to back 25 startups across the CEE region.
Established in 2010, KAYA is a generalist venture capital fund that invests globally.
KAYA Fund V will invest in early-stage startups — from pre-seed to Series A — across the CEE region.
Its initial cheques will range from €1 to €3 million, with the option to invest up to €20 million in a company over time.

investice.citace: Several products later, that partnership has produced Viktor, an AI agent that operates like a virtual coworker embedded inside a company’s Slack or Microsoft Teams workspace. The company has just raised a $75 million Series A, led by London-based venture capital firm Accel with participation from Bek Ventures, Kaya VC, Inovo VC, and Tenacity Capital.

Jutro Medical raised €12 million in Series A funding, led by KAYA VC and RIO ASI, to further develop its medical AI agents and modernise traditional telemedicine workflows. Details of the deal The extended Series A was led by Warsaw Equity Group, with participation from Vinci, naturalX Health Ventures, Fluent Ventures, Aternus, KAYA VC, and Inovo VC

Prague-based firm TopK, which builds an AI-powered search engine for better data retrieval, has secured $5.5 million in a seed funding round from Earlybird, KAYA, Irregular Expressions, and several angel investors, as Vestbee was told.

Hungarian cybersecurity startup Riptides, which offers a universal and transparent non-human identity solution, has secured $3.3 million in a pre-seed funding round led by PortfoLion Capital Partners, with support from KAYA VC.

poznamka: DUPLICITA: Enern se přejmenoval na KAYA (web kaya.vc, stejný tým a fondy ENERN TECH III a IV; v ARES je i subjekt IČO 10838821 „KAYA (fka Enern) s.r.o.“, https://ares.gov.cz/ekonomicke-subjekty-v-be/rest/ekonomicke-subjekty/10838821). Jde o stejný subjekt jako kandidát „Kaya VC“ (dávka 8, kaya-vc.json); při slučování ponechat jeden záznam. Jako nazev/ico uveden fond ENERN Investments SICAV z kontaktu na enern.eu; od 1. 6. 2025 ho podle výroční zprávy ET IV 2025 obhospodařuje AVANT investiční společnost, a.s. Investice jsou doloženy články pod značkou KAYA / Kaya VC. Kapitál: web kaya.vc uvádí $500M AUM celkem a $85M aktuální fond; Vestbee (2025-06) uvádí první uzavření fondu V na 70 mil. EUR. Sektory deklarované jako generalista podle Vestbee; starší fond ET IV měl ve statutu fintech, e-commerce, zdraví, edtech a proptech. Datum webu kaya.vc a enern.eu se nepodařilo doložit. Jutro Medical: KAYA VC v 03/2025 vedl kolo A (12 mil. EUR) a v 12/2025 se účastnil jeho rozšíření (24 mil. EUR); zapsáno rozšíření. Další kandidáti z portfolia (PrimVeterinary 2026) byli doloženi jen agregátory, proto nezapsáni.
